scores.label: A
scores.note: option 1 opens with 'Consequently', inventing a causal link to the smallpox sentence; option 2 drops the 'when enough people are vaccinated' condition and 'This' has no antecedent; 3 says immunity is conferred on the unvaccinated (loose); 4 'Such' has no antecedent

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 3 changes 'enough' to 'a majority' (invents a threshold) and 'cannot get the shot' to 'unvaccinated'; 2, 4, 5 pull in the next sentence's 'herd immunity' and are long; 4 adds 'vaccine-preventable diseases'

scores.label: C
scores.note: options 4 and 5 add the hedge 'can', weakening the certainty; 4 also broadens to all unvaccinated individuals
